# nerves_uevent v0.1.7 - Table of Contents

> Simple UEvent monitor for detecting hardware and automatically loading drivers

## Pages

- [NervesUEvent](https://nerves-uevent.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [NervesUEvent](https://nerves-uevent.hexdocs.pm/NervesUEvent.md): NervesUEvent listens for events from the Linux kernel, automatically loads
device drivers, and forwards them to your Elixir programs.
